verdict.rationale: Render doesn't offer a native in-product AI insights/analytics feature, but it does support agent-driven suggestions via its MCP server and Claude/Cursor 'skills' — e.g. an agent can inspect CPU/memory metrics and recommend a compute plan change (render-docs-33), and 20+ official skills give agents guidance for monitoring/scaling (render-docs-34). This is mediated through external coding agents rather than a built-in insights engine. Missing for 10: a first-party AI insights/analytics dashboard inside Render's own UI, independent evidence of these agent recommendations being used in practice.
